answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. Refundable entry stake: each identity locks 54 POA that vests back in slices across 10 epochs, only while its grading record stays clean; one confirmed junk verdict freezes the remainder. Running 780 fakes locks 42120 POA for months. The cliff is the point: quitting early forfeits the whole grant. What carries the cipher here is verification, the plume of cost is what stops the farm, and the comet of the record keeps every claim checkable. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
